paper.title: Retroformer: Retrospective Large Language Agents with Policy Gradient Optimization
paper.claim_type_reason: The contribution is training an auxiliary component (retrospective LM) from environment returns and plugging it into a frozen agent; no standalone closed self-modifying loop, so not system_method; not a benchmark.
paper.scope_class: B (reflection-prompt optimizer; boundary case: trains weights of an auxiliary improver, actor weights untouched)

central_claim.text: Learning a plug-in retrospective language model by policy gradient (PPO on episode-return differences) automatically refines a frozen actor LLM's prompts from environment feedback, so language agents improve over trials and considerably outperform baselines that do not leverage gradients (ReAct, Reflexion) on HotPotQA, AlfWorld and WebShop.

Our arithmetic from reported rates: N=4 Retroformer-minus-Reflexion = HotPotQA +3/+4 (GPT-3), +1/+2 (GPT-4); AlfWorld +15.7 (GPT-3), +14.9 (GPT-4); WebShop +1/+1 (GPT-3), +1/+2 (GPT-4). Binomial SE of one rate at n=100,p=0.5 is ~5 pts, so HotPotQA/WebShop margins vs Reflexion are within single-run noise; AlfWorld 15 pts at n=134 is ~4-5 SE of a difference. No variance/test is reported (this is a heuristic, not our run).

Headline 18/36/4 pts is not reproduced by one stated comparator: HotPotQA 54 vs ReAct-GPT-3 34 = +20, vs ReAct-GPT-4 40 = +14, vs Reflexion 50 = +4; AlfWorld 100 vs ReAct-GPT-3 62.69 = +37.3; WebShop 46 vs ReAct-GPT-4 42 = +4. Comparisons against ReAct also conflate retries with learning.

gap.author_gap: Existing language agents are not optimized with environment rewards; reflective agents (Reflexion) rely on a frozen LLM for self-reflection, which is hard (credit assignment) and incompatible with gradient-based learning
gap.checked_gap: Real and specific: the reflection generator is a fixed prompted component in Reflexion. The claim that frozen reflectors fail at credit assignment is supported only by one hand-picked example (Fig.1/5), not by a measured failure rate; 'not compatible with gradient learning' is a design preference rather than a measured bottleneck

rs_pattern.reason: Operation actually executed: manufacture a supervisory signal for reflection quality that no label provides, by rolling out candidate reflections and ranking them by downstream return difference, then training the reflector on that ranking via reward model + PPO. This is C26's 'comparative/scalar reward from execution-verified vs failed trajectories, consumed by a preference/RL objective'. Supporting: Sec.3 recasts prompt refinement through a frozen black-box LLM as a one-step RL problem by placing the actor inside the environment (reframe_as_solvable_object). adapt_via_conditioning was considered (actor is adapted by conditioning on reflections, no actor updates) and rejected as supporting because the trained object, not the conditioning schema, is the contribution.

assessment.evidence_level_reason: A weight-bearing reflector trained on training-task rollouts is evaluated on separate dev/eval tasks and beats the Reflexion comparator, strongly on AlfWorld. Not 'improver': no budget-matched, same-model control comparing the trained vs untrained improver is readable (LoRA r=0 series unreadable), and only one offline training round exists. Component-level retention only (actor and harness text store unchanged); attribution is confounded, so this sits at the low end of 'retained'.
assessment.author_claim: Policy-gradient learned retrospective model considerably outperforms baselines that do not leverage gradients and improves agents over time
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: With a frozen GPT-3 actor and oracle outcome feedback over retries, a LongChat-7B LoRA reflector trained offline by SFT+RM+PPO on dG ratings beats Reflexion on AlfWorld by ~15 points (single run, n=134) and is not distinguishable from it on HotPotQA (+1-4) or WebShop (+1-2) at n=100; whether the policy-gradient step, SFT on positive reflections, RM best-of-n or reflector model identity produces the gain is not isolated. Author-reported only; no reproduction.

G.reason: 优点：点名了过去固定而本文改变的非权重对象——Reflexion 类方法里由冻结 LLM 写的 reflection（E002、E041）；最近邻 Reflexion/Self-Refine/RAP 在 Sec.2 与 Table 1 区分，gap 对应具体失效模式（遗忘目标、重述旧动作 → 循环）。扣分：残余瓶颈只有一个手选 HotPotQA 例子（E003、E040）支撑，没有量化冻结 reflection 无效的比例；关键同类邻居（RL/优化式 prompt 或 reflection 学习、微调 agent 的并行工作）不在已钉死材料里，无法核对，记入 gap.unresolved；Table 1 只比 5 个被选系统。介于锚点 2 与 4。

M.reason: 操作可重建：Mr(轨迹, 回报)→reflection→追加到冻结 actor 的 prompt；用相邻两次 trial 的回报差 ΔG 作为 reflection 的评分（E009、E010），再 SFT→RM→PPO+KL（E026、E011）；把 actor 视为环境使 Mr 成为一步 RL 策略（E004），与 'reflector 质量'这一 gap 对准，且保持黑盒 actor 不动。弱点：ΔG 归因假设（actor T=0 ⇒ 差异来自 reflection，E009、E031）未验证，任何 prompt 扰动都可能改变轨迹；奖励在 Eq.5（数值差）、Eq.6（学习的 RM）与 Algorithm 1（配对 accepted/rejected）三处表述不一致（E028-E030）；没有对朴素替代（仅对正评分样本 SFT、仅 best-of-n+RM、更大冻结 reflector）给出可区分预测。

X.reason: 按 component_training 解释：接口（Mr↔actor prompt，E006-E007、E036）、数据/教师可见性（轨迹+回报，actor 黑盒，E005、E015）、训练与部署（数据量 E024，三阶段超参 E026-E027，LoRA 规格 E025，prompt 全文见附录 E）基本可重建，且下一轮读取已在 actor prompt 模板中验证（E036）。缺口：best-of-n 的 n、RM 输入/标签细节、各环境是否共享一个 Mr、GPT-4 是否迁移（E015）均未写；Algorithm 1 第 1 行与正文矛盾（E030）；LoRA 超参在 'epochs=4,bs=8' 与分阶段列表间不一致（E025、E027）；没有 reflection 的筛选/淘汰/版本/回退，也无失效边界讨论（仅 WebShop 承认受限，E021）。保留/门控类条件对本类型多数不适用，不据此加分。

E.measurement.reason: 环境本身是客观验证器（HotPotQA 答案匹配、AlfWorld 二值成功、WebShop 属性匹配奖励，E034-E035），与 Reflexion 同一评测集（E013）。但：HotPotQA/WebShop 的 test 'success rate' 未定义；测试时每次重试依赖环境真值信号（E037），结论只适用于带 oracle 反馈的多次重试设定；引言 18/36/4 与 Table 2 对不上任何单一对照（E001、E043）；SAC 基线换了 actor 且不可比（E033）；所有数字为作者报告、代码未发布（E032）；Table 2/Fig.4/6 的 N 与 Episode 索引语义不清。

E.causality.reason: 可读证据里只有 Reflexion（冻结 GPT-3 reflector，E014）作对照，它同时改变了 reflector 模型身份、任务特化 SFT、RM best-of-n、PPO 四件事，无法把增益归因于'策略梯度'本身。未见：同规模冻结 reflector（仅 Fig.4 图例有 LoRA r=0，数值不可读，文中不讨论，E023）、仅 SFT、仅 RM best-of-n、关 PPO、随机评分、reflection 质量的定量度量（E044）；r=1 vs r=4 差异≤3 点（E017-E018）只说明参数量不是主因。定性案例（E003、E040）有提示性但手选。AlfWorld 的大幅提升（E042）使'训练的 reflector 有用'可信，但主张的因果环节未被隔离，低于锚点 2。

E.holdout.reason: 训练数据来自训练集任务（HotPotQA 3,000 个训练任务，AlfWorld 523/WebShop 267 条 reflection，E024），评测在 dev/OOD 评测任务上（E013），reflector 本身是在留出任务上评的——这是实质性的留出。缺口：未说明 checkpoint/超参是否在评测任务上选择（用词 'validation tasks'，E013）；无单独 dev/test；评测集小；预训练 GPT-3/4 对 HotPotQA/维基数据的污染未讨论；GPT-4 为迁移还是重训未说明（E015）；'跨多环境学习'（E038）与'可用于其它组件'（E039）超出实验范围；收益含 oracle 重试信号（E037）。

E.statistics.reason: 分母明确且含全部任务（100/134/100，成功率），WebShop 受限被如实承认（E021）。但全文单次运行，无种子、CI、显著性检验，PPO 训练方差未报告（E044）；HotPotQA/WebShop 对 Reflexion 的 1–4 点差异在 n=100 的二项噪声范围内（E042）。

E.cost.reason: 报告了可训练参数（0.53M/2.25M）、数据条数（E024）、训练步数（E027）、硬件（A100 40GB），但没有 GPU 时数/API 调用数/收集 3,000×3 trial 及成对 rollout 的成本，best-of-n 的 n 未给出（E012），推理期采样预算与 Reflexion 不对等；没有匹配预算比较，也没有把训练成本与收益对账（E044）。

status.reason: Complete PDF-derived material (incl. appendix E) read; all eight items resolved with evidence; figure curve values unavailable are treated as unknown evidence, not as absence of the experiment.

rationale: 组件训练：PPO 训练 reflector。AlfWorld 比 Reflexion 高约15点，HotPotQA/WebShop 差值在噪声内；缺同规模冻结/SFT-only 消融、种子与成本。G/M/X中等，E弱。
